annotations.title: Compare deposit rates for a balance and requirements

description: Compare observed US savings and CD APYs for a balance, holding period, state, monthly-fee, and direct-deposit requirements. Returns sourced facts, unknown/conflicting term checks, and conditional gross-interest illustrations; unknown terms never count as a match. No eligibility decision, personalized offer, application, or account opening. Use for multi-constraint deposit matching; use get_savings_rates or get_cd_rates for simple rate tables, calculate_deposit_earnings_difference for a quick two-APY dollar gap, or get_rate_watch_report for weekly rate-change alerts.

balance.description: Starting deposit in USD; resolves balance-tier APYs and checks opening-deposit minimums (no account identifiers needed).

horizon_months.description: Illustrative holding period in months (1-120, default 12). CD gross-interest illustrations require an exactly matching CD term.

product.description: Product scope to compare: 'savings' (default), 'cd' (requires a CD term exactly matching horizon_months), or 'all' (both savings and matching-term CDs).

require_no_direct_deposit.description: When true, requires the published APY without a direct-deposit requirement.

require_no_monthly_fee.description: When true, requires zero monthly maintenance fee without a conditional waiver.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state or territory postal code (e.g. 'NY', 'CA') to check published geographic availability; unknown availability stays needs_verification.

name: compare_deposit_options

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the comparison was computed.

options.description: Evaluated deposit options with applicable APY, term checks, and illustrative gross interest.

unavailable_sources.description: Observed sources excluded due to staleness or invalid data.
